environment.description: AWS Step Functions Activity Worker running on Amazon Linux 2 EC2 instance (t3.medium). Container runtime is Docker 24.0 with default seccomp profile. The worker process runs as uid 1000 inside the container with /tmp mounted as a tmpfs volume. No MAC (Mandatory Access Control) policy is applied. The container has CAP_KILL capability retained for inter-process signaling between workflow stages. Host filesystem is bind-mounted at /tmp for cross-container state sharing.
